scope: Japan medical discovery — Hokkaido University Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Hokkaido University's School of Medicine describes a six-year undergraduate programme divided into liberal education, basic medicine, clinical medicine and clinical clerkship courses.

Hokkaido University's clinical-clerkship guidance states that fourth-year students begin clinical training at Hokkaido University Hospital, fifth-year students undertake six four-week core clerkships, and sixth-year students complete three four-week elective attachments.

As of 1 April 2026, Hokkaido University's international-student handbook lists an undergraduate examination fee of JPY 17,000, entrance fee of JPY 282,000 and annual tuition of JPY 535,800, with partial or full fee waivers for eligible self-supported regular students.
Hokkaido University's Medicine admissions policy says privately financed international applicants are assessed through an external English test, Japanese-language testing, an essay and an interview.

holdReasons: The current official undergraduate entry-admissions evidence was not assembled in sufficient detail for all required payload fields.
Recognition and student-support evidence remains incomplete for publication, and the medicine teaching language needs an explicit current primary-source confirmation.
